judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core mechanism of querying `store.listFor(session.userId)` off the turn lock and serialising dates to ISO strings, but it invents its own protocol names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the exact types and frame names specified in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It directly violates several explicit requirements and acceptance criteria: it omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config (defaulting to always enabled), returns an empty list instead of `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` when `listFor` is missing, allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of enforcing 1–200, and logs `error.message` on store failure. Furthermore, it leaves an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff and completely omits the requested updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `StoreCannotList`.
